# bg_run

Start a named long-running shell command in the background; returns immediately with task ID, PID, and output path. Default terminal notification starts a follow-up turn; do not poll or sleep merely to wait. Output is stored in .pi/tasks, with model-visible log reads capped at 50 KiB. Commands run with local permissions, not in a sandbox.

**Dynamic shell suffix:** BG_RUN_DESCRIPTION + shellPolicyDescription(shellPolicy): append the activation-selected executable, argv and command syntax; never extract a local shell path or execute extension code.

The suffix describes the actual spawn policy; it is not a system-prompt hook.

| Parameter | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | yes | string | Short human-readable task name shown in the bg footer dock. Required; use 2-6 words, not the raw command. |
| `command` | yes | string | Required shell command; runs in the session working directory. |
| `description` | no | string | Longer human-readable task context. Default: none. |
| `timeoutSeconds` | no | number | Timeout in seconds, rounded down to whole seconds; task fails and is killed when exceeded. Default: no timeout. |
| `notifyOnCompletion` | no | boolean | Deliver a terminal notification. Default: true. When false, triggerOnCompletion has no effect. |
| `triggerOnCompletion` | no | boolean | Automatically start a follow-up agent turn on terminal notification. Default: true; inactive when notifyOnCompletion is false. |
| `surviveReload` | no | boolean | Retain this exact shell execution across a real same-process Pi reload. Default: false. Does not survive exit, restart, or session replacement. |
